title: The Man Who Counted His Children
summary: A neighbor asked Nasruddin: "How many children do you have, Mulla?"...
keywords: the man who counted his children
full_text:
A neighbor asked Nasruddin: "How many children do you have, Mulla?"

Nasruddin counted on his fingers: "I have Hassan, Fatima, Ali, and Maryam—that is four. But when they are all screaming at once, I have at least forty-four!"
moral: A parent's love embraces all children equally without arithmetic division.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
